name: meble-app-firebase-pilot-tests
description: Isolated Firebase emulators and Web SDK tests; no application bundler or live deployment.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project demo-meble-app --only auth,firestore --non-interactive "node --test --test-concurrency=1 pilot.test.mjs auth.test.mjs access.test.mjs global.test.mjs live-readiness.test.mjs cloud42-plan.test.mjs cloud44-admin.test.mjs cloud46c-executor.test.mjs cloud46d-emulator.test.mjs cloud46e-emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:live-readiness: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase-live-pilot.json --project demo-meble-app --only auth,firestore --non-interactive "node --test live-readiness.test.mjs"
scripts.test:browser: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project demo-meble-app --only auth,firestore --non-interactive "node --test auth-browser.test.mjs"
scripts.test:private-pilot: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase-live-pilot.json --project demo-meble-app --only auth,firestore --non-interactive "node --test --test-name-pattern=CLOUD-4.1 auth-browser.test.mjs"
scripts.test:cloud42-plan: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase-live-pilot.json --project demo-meble-app --only auth,firestore --non-interactive "node --test cloud42-plan.test.mjs"
